shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,140p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n---RELEVANT ROUTING---\\n' && rg -n -i -C 2 'landing|uikit|website|marketing' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n---PACKAGE---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n---TRAPS---\\n' && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && printf '\\n---SOURCE---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '400,435p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n 'page-constructor' package-lock.json package.json || true && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null | head"

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh page-constructor PageConstructor PageConstructorProvider && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json | head -40 && rg -n 'Required setup|PageConstructorProvider|PageConstructor' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/dist/docs/INDEX.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh page-constructor PageConstructor PageConstructorProvider && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json | head -40 && rg -n 'Required setup|PageConstructorProvider|PageConstructor' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/dist/docs/INDEX.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/INDEX.md && sed -n '1,175p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md && rg -n 'styles.css|Required setup|hero|features|banner|button' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -70 && rg -n '\"@gravity-ui/(uikit|page-constructor|markdown-editor|yfm)' package.json"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '500,540p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md && cat vite.config.ts && cat index.html && npm ls sass vite-plugin-dynamic-import @diplodoc/transform --depth=0"

/bin/bash -lc "npm ls @gravity-ui/uikit @gravity-ui/components @gravity-ui/page-constructor --depth=2 && rg -n 'interface PageConstructorProviderProps|theme\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.d.ts && rg -n 'type Theme|enum Theme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit --glob '*.d.ts' | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.css && cat node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/package.json | head -90 && rg --files node_modules/@diplodoc/transform | rg 'yfm\\.css"'$|dist/css'"' | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/App.tsx vite.config.ts src/app.css src/main.tsx index.html package.json'
